# 2 Baruch Chapter 72 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal)
**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** Syriac MS (Codex Ambrosianus 7a1) | **Section:** The Cloud and Waters Vision

---

**1** "And now hear concerning the bright lightning which came at the end, after the black waters."

**2** "This is the word. After all the signs of which I have spoken to you shall have come, when the nations are troubled, and the time of my Messiah has come,"

**3** "he will summon all the nations, and some of them he will spare, and some of them he will slay."

**4** "These are the things that will befall the nations that have not known my people: every nation that has not known Israel, and that has not trodden down the seed of Jacob, will be spared."

**5** "And this will be so, because some among all the nations have been subject to your people."

**6** "But all those who have ruled over you, or have known you, will be given up to the sword."

---

*LOGOS notes: Formal equivalence rendering from the Syriac (Codex Ambrosianus 7a1). Paragraph divisions follow the sense units of the source.*
